route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Alan, Tal Teok Temple north of Tal Teklan Dialogue: "Yes."
Talk to Alan again. Dialogue: "Of course!."
Talk to King, the bartender in The King's Inn west of the bank. Dialogue: "Scrumpty Rumpty fell off a wall!."
Talk to Acatzin in the inn Dialogue: "I can talk to the blacksmith!."
Fill the bowl with water at the fountain outside.
Talk to Nezketi at the temple directly south of the inn for an empty cup. Dialogue: "I can get you some tea!."
Talk to Kauayotl, outside the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan. Dialogue: "I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?"
Return to Tal Teok Temple and speak to any of King's men.
Speak to each of King's men to initiate a cutscene.

Put the egg together - players can hover over the puzzle piece icon to view the solution. When a piece is rotated in the correct orientation and placed in the correct location, it will stay in place indicating the correct placement.
